Hide a secret plane in a desert shed,
and you have Area 51.
But people sneak in for photos.
So you put up signs:
cross this line, and the guards will shoot.
But on flat desert,
your shed is visible for miles.
So you build it in a valley,
walled in by mountains, like the sides of a bowl.
But the desert is too big to fence.
So you bury sensors that feel every footstep,
and white trucks are waiting before anyone reaches the top.
But radar can spot your plane.
So you build it flat, with sharp angles.
Radar bounces away, and never comes back.
This is a stealth plane.
But cameras in space see the whole valley.
So the plane hides all day, and flies only at night.
And the real base goes underground, where no camera sees through rock.
But at night,
the next town sees a strange flat shape slide across the stars.
They say they saw a UFO,
and nobody believes them.
So the more people see your plane...
the better hidden it is.
